description: Defines what constitutes A-grade (90th percentile) execution quality for the V2 paper trading system

fill_quality.current_status: MET — all paper fills at entry_price, slippage model ~2 bps

decision_latency.current_status: UNVERIFIED — no decision_latency field in closed trade records

signal_freshness.criterion: Prediction age < 900s at time of trade decision
signal_freshness.current_status: MET — stale predictions excluded from candidates (0 PIT violations)

feature_completeness.criterion: All core features populated (squeeze, spread, drawdown)
feature_completeness.current_status: FAIL — squeeze null 100%, spread constant, drawdown always zero

long_short_balance.criterion: Both LONG and SHORT paths exercised (min 20% each)

trailing_stop_wr.criterion: Trailing stop WR > 40% (stop activates and protects profit)
trailing_stop_wr.current_status: FAIL — TS WR=10.1% (fires at loss 89.9% of the time)

what_90p_execution_tier_requires: Trailing stop WR ≥ 40% after parameter tuning
LONG path exercised with minimum 50 trades
squeeze_evidence_score populated on all future trades
Real bid-ask spread wired (not constant 2.0 bps)
Drawdown guard functional (non-zero drawdown_at_entry when account is down)
